        skip_ids.add(n['id'])

        skip_ids.add(n['id'])
    if n['color'] == 'R':  # HUD
        skip_ids.add(n['id'])
    if n['color'] == 'G' and n['pixels'] > 50:  # HUD bar
        skip_ids.add(n['id'])

# Find a white dot to click
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['id'] not in skip_ids and n['color'] == 'W':
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        center = ((min(rows)+max(rows))//2, (min(cols)+max(cols))//2)
        print(f"Clicking white dot at {center}")
        result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center[0], 'col': center[1]}])
        print(f"Result: {last_action_result}")
        break

# Check what changed
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
color_counts2 = {}
for n in seg2['nodes']:
    if n['id'] not in skip_ids:
        color_counts2[n['color']] = color_counts2.get(n['color'], 0) + 1
print(f"Object counts after click: {color_counts2}")
